_README.note: HO 693. Every .tsx under components/ and app/ whose code (comments stripped) references kalshi|polymarket|SourceTag|impliedPct|favoriteLabel must appear here. `npm run check:odds-sites` fails CI on an unlisted match AND on a listed file that no longer matches. Reasons: gated = renders market data and carries odds-only + data-market; consumer-of-gated-primitive = renders market data only via SourceTag/KalshiLine/the signals tape, which carry the class and marker themselves; not-a-render-site = matches the words but renders no market data. This key is itself listed so the file is never empty-looking; it matches nothing and is skipped by the stale check via the leading underscore.

components/SourceTag.tsx.note: The K/P letter primitive. Emits data-market itself, so every consumer is covered.

components/race-cells.tsx.note: KalshiLine — odds-only + data-market on its root; three consumers ride it.

components/MarketsTapeClient.tsx.note: Emits data-market on all three root branches when kind === 'signals'. The MARKETS strip is deliberately ungated and is deliberately unmarked.

components/RaceCard.tsx.note: K/P line, both market diamonds, the divergence chip, and the leader line's dual render.

components/RaceListView.tsx.note: The divergence column (visibility:hidden — it is a fixed-track grid child) and the readout clause.

components/RacesHeroBand.tsx.note: Two KALSHI control cells; the attribute rule re-shapes the band to one column on OFF.

components/RaceDistrictModal.tsx.note: Not DOM: the export markdown drops its Kalshi line by reading data-odds at CLICK time. Covered by scripts/diagnostic/odds-toggle-692.ts, which intercepts the Blob — the OFF pass cannot see a string.

app/welcome/page.tsx.note: The landing's ODDS taperow. A CSS-module row, so unlike the dashboard tape it is NOT hidden below 700px — 430 is a real test of it.

app/welcome/panels.tsx.note: A local sourceTag() that labels a NEWS source (politico / the_hill / roll_call). A false positive on the word; nothing to do with prediction markets.
